A future real-project E2E can validate a RED gate surviving one bounded corrective cycle and returning PARTIAL/BLOCKED instead of recursively extending the chat.
decisions: A RED or unavailable required gate changes terminal status; it does not remove the obligation to terminate the turn.
Default unchanged-fingerprint cycle is diagnose once from concrete evidence, at most one corrective edit for that diagnosis, then one affected revalidation.
If the same fingerprint remains after the bounded cycle, terminalize PARTIAL/BLOCKED/FAILED and report instead of recursively starting one more check.
ULW and similar autonomous requests permit deeper work but never infinite retry, search, wait, or polling loops.
True host/session stalls remain covered by 0.6 terminal snapshots, takeover, and fencing; Sloar still cannot control the host spinner itself.
